function_signature: def crt_rsa_sign(m: int, p: int, q: int, dp: int, dq: int, qinv: int) -> int
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.95 (16 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: A full-value modular exponentiation to the modulus p*q directly (such as pow(m, d, p*q)) is not allowed — the three CRT steps must be followed
The modular exponentiation must be implemented yourself (pow must not be used for it); square-and-multiply, window methods and any other correct form are acceptable
The CRT formulas: Sp=m^dp mod p, Sq=m^dq mod q, S=Sq+q*((Sp-Sq)*qinv mod p) mod (p*q)
Sp-Sq may be negative and must be handled correctly with (Sp-Sq) % p
p, q, dp, dq and qinv are positive integers; m satisfies 0<=m<p*q
source: 《密码工程》(Cryptographic Engineering, in Chinese) Ch.4 §5; HAC §14.71; PKCS#1 v2.2 §5.1.2
author: Liang Jing
